title: Operations board
idea: Operations board: Stage columns show work objects and blocked transitions
audience: People who need to coordinate within a dashboard surface.
avoidWhen: A board hides essential numeric comparison
distinctFrom: Differs from a generic workspace layout through its coordinate priority and explicit commitment contract: Stage movement validates permissions and server acknowledgement
navigation: Operations board keeps the current coordinate context visible; secondary detail has an explicit return path.

composition.entry: Stage columns show work objects and blocked transitions
composition.continuation: Continue with the evidence and controls needed to coordinate; teams manage a bounded flow
composition.priority: Stage movement validates permissions and server acknowledgement

imagery.role: Support the actual coordinate context; essential controls and state remain native.

brandConstraints: Preserve approved identity, semantic roles and licensed assets.
Treat font and palette suggestions as optional; do not replace fixed branding.
responsiveRules: Stack stages while preserving filters and selected work
Keep units, filters and selection understandable at narrow widths; expose a focused item view.

stateContracts.loading: Keep the operations board structure stable while authoritative content resolves; expose unavailable action state.
stateContracts.empty: Explain why no coordinate content is available and offer a relevant next action.
stateContracts.failure: Preserve safe context and identify the failed operation; Stage movement validates permissions and server acknowledgement
stateContracts.offline: Label cached/unsynchronized coordinate content and prevent claims of server completion.
stateContracts.success: Stage movement validates permissions and server acknowledgement
stateContracts.interruption: Restore the active coordinate context safely after navigation, focus loss or platform interruption; do not replay committed actions.

accessibilityRisks: Do not communicate state through color alone; name controls and expose current selection.
Verify reading order, input alternatives, enlarged text and focus restoration for this composition.

performanceBudget.principle: Set an explicit project budget from the actual content/device; no unsupported universal frame or bundle promise.
performanceBudget.verify: Measure bounded queries and large-data interaction; virtualize only with accessible alternatives.

reviewNotes: Original authored candidate with browser study renders. Automated browser checks are recorded in evals/specimen-review.json. No independent visual comparison, task study or native runtime verification; remains draft. The illustration/task content demonstrates composition and does not prescribe every linked palette or font.
